```{=html}
<style>
/* Reset title area */
.page-title { display: none; }

/* Full viewport hero */
.hero-opening {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 80px 70px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eaf3df, #f7f2e8, #d8e8d2);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 60px;
}

/* Floating blobs */
.blob {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 60% 40% 55% 45%;
  background: rgba(91, 137, 91, 0.15);
  animation: floatBlob 9s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index: 1;
}
.blob-1 { width: 280px; height: 280px; top: 5%; right: 20%; animation-delay: 0s; }
.blob-2 { width: 180px; height: 180px; bottom: 10%; left: 5%; animation-delay: 2s; }
.blob-3 { width: 120px; height: 120px; top: 55%; right: 42%; animation-delay: 4s; }

@keyframes floatBlob {
  0%   { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  50%  { transform: translateY(-28px) rotate(10deg); }
  100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
}

/* Hero text */
.hero-text {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(40px);
  transition: opacity 1s ease, transform 1s ease;
}
.hero-text.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.hero-text .label {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #6a9e6a;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.hero-text h1 {
  font-size: 4.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #23482c;
  line-height: 1.05;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

/* Typewriter underline */
.hero-text h1 span {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}
.hero-text h1 span::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 4px;
  left: 0;
  width: 0%;
  height: 4px;
  background: #4f8f5f;
  border-radius: 2px;
  animation: drawLine 1.2s ease 0.8s forwards;
}
@keyframes drawLine {
  to { width: 100%; }
}

.hero-text p {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: #3a5a3e;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 480px;
}

/* Photo */
.hero-photo {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(40px);
  transition: opacity 1.1s ease 0.3s, transform 1.1s ease 0.3s;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}
.hero-photo.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(0);
}
.hero-photo img {
  width: 300px;
  height: 390px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 70px rgba(47, 93, 58, 0.3);
  transition: transform 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}
.hero-photo img:hover {
  transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
  box-shadow: 0 44px 90px rgba(47, 93, 58, 0.35);
}


</style>

<div class="hero-opening">
  <div class="blob blob-1"></div>
  <div class="blob blob-2"></div>
  <div class="blob blob-3"></div>

  <div class="hero-text" id="heroText">
    <p class="label">Portfolio · 2025</p>
    <h1><span>Yingyi Guo</span></h1>
    <p>Business Analytics graduate student with a background in landscape architecture.</p>
    <p>I focus on data analytics, spatial thinking, and environmental systems.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="hero-photo" id="heroPhoto">
    <img src="profile.jpg" alt="Yingyi Guo" />
  </div>

  <div class="scroll-hint" onclick="window.location.href='projects.html'" style="cursor:pointer;">
    <span>Scroll</span>
    <div class="arrow"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// Trigger entrance animations on load
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('heroText').classList.add('visible');
    document.getElementById('heroPhoto').classList.add('visible');
  }, 100);
});
</script>
```
